packages.description: A Nushell plugin to manipulate SemVer versions: parse, compare, sort, bump, and match against version requirements. The catalog remains Windows-only pending intake and lifecycle evidence for the supported upstream Linux/macOS .tar.xz assets.

A Nushell test framework: discovers and runs @test-annotated commands with rich reporting and output capture. Commands are imported unprefixed (e.g. `run-tests`, not upstream's documented `nutest run-tests`): Numan's activation currently imports the mod.nu file directly rather than the containing directory, so Nu does not apply its directory-name-to-module-name convention here. v1.1.0 uses a registry-hosted mirror of upstream's tag archive; v1.2.0+ uses upstream's uploaded release assets for byte-stable hash pinning.
Nushell plugin for ULID generation, parsing, and manipulation. Full cross-platform release assets in Numan-supported formats (.tar.gz and .zip).

Nushell plugin for generating tones, reading/writing audio metadata, and playing audio files. Upstream v0.2.10 (Nu 0.114.1): Windows zip, Linux aarch64 tar.gz, and macOS/Linux x86_64 tar.xz (nested cargo-dist layout).
Inspect a file and return information based on its magic number. CI-built from fdncred/nu_plugin_file@v0.26.0 and signed under the official trust root.
Git repository management tools for Nushell (prompts, status, utilities). Artifact is a registry-hosted mirror of upstream tag 0.8.0 (pkgs/nu-git-manager); upstream has no uploaded release zip.

Load bash-style .env files and shell functions into Nushell (replacement for deprecated nu_plugin_bash_env). Requires bash-env-json on PATH. v0.19.0 uses upstream's uploaded release asset (see tesujimath/bash-env-nushell#50).
Tools for Nushell module developers. Registry-hosted mirror of upstream tag 0.0.18.
Reproducible Nushell Markdown documents. Registry-hosted mirror of upstream tag 0.4.0.

Official Nushell hook scripts from nu_scripts (direnv, autojump, command_not_found, etc.). Registry-hosted mirror of nu_scripts @ f04cb44. Install-only for now: no single mod.nu entry; per-hook activation is manual.
Community custom completions from nu_scripts (git, cargo, npm, gh, …). Registry-hosted mirror of nu_scripts/custom-completions @ f04cb44. Install-only: completion activation is deferred in Numan.
Nushell plugin for parsing pcap (packet capture) files. Full cross-platform release assets in Numan-supported formats (.tar.gz).
Nushell plugin for streaming output from WebSocket endpoints. Release assets are available for macOS, x86_64 Linux, and x86_64 Windows in Numan-supported formats (.tar.gz and .zip).
Nushell plugin for user interaction dialogs. The catalog remains Windows-only pending intake and lifecycle evidence for the supported upstream Linux/macOS .tar.xz assets.
Weather fetcher for Nushell using wttr.in. Registry-hosted mirror of upstream @ main. Install-only: script activation is deferred in Numan.
Git prompt sugar for nu-git-manager (right prompt, completions). Registry-hosted mirror of upstream tag 0.7.0 (pkgs/nu-git-manager-sugar).
Git custom completions from nu_scripts. Registry-hosted mirror of nu_scripts/custom-completions/git @ f04cb44. Install-only: completion activation is deferred in Numan.
Syntax highlighting for Nushell values and code. CI-built from cptpiepmatz/nu-plugin-highlight@v1.4.16+0.114.1 and signed under the official trust root.
Search text with regular expressions in Nushell pipelines. CI-built from fdncred/nu_plugin_regex@v0.23.0 and signed under the official trust root.

DNS utility for Nushell. CI-built from dead10ck/nu_plugin_dns@v4.0.10. Pending official trust-root signing on production publish. Linux and macOS only for now: upstream's Cargo.lock pulls conflicting windows-sys versions that fail to build against nu-protocol 0.113 on Windows.
Fuzzy finder (skim) integration for Nushell. CI-built from idanarye/nu_plugin_skim@v0.29.1 and signed under the official trust root.
Send desktop notifications from Nushell. CI-built from FMotalleb/nu_plugin_desktop_notifications@v0.114.1 and signed under the official trust root.
Inspect active network connections and scan ports from Nushell. CI-built from FMotalleb/nu_plugin_port_extension@v0.114.1 and signed under the official trust root.
Render images in the terminal and save ANSI text as images. CI-built from FMotalleb/nu_plugin_image@v0.112.2 and signed under the official trust root.
Query Prometheus from Nushell (instant/range queries, targets, labels, scrape). CI-built from drbrain/nu_plugin_prometheus@v0.12.0 and signed under the official trust root.
Search and insert emoji characters in Nushell pipelines. CI-built from fdncred/nu_plugin_emoji@v0.23.0 and signed under the official trust root.
Query JSON data with JSONPath expressions in Nushell. CI-built from fdncred/nu_plugin_json_path@v0.24.0 and signed under the official trust root.
Read and write Apache Parquet files in Nushell. CI-built from fdncred/nu_plugin_parquet@v0.24.0 and signed under the official trust root.
Convert between BSON (Binary JSON) and Nushell values. CI-built from Kissaki/nu_plugin_bson@v26.1140.0 and signed under the official trust root.
HMAC sealing and verification from Nushell. CI-built from fnuttens/nu_plugin_hmac@0.27.0 and signed under the official trust root.
Parse HashiCorp HCL into Nushell values. CI-built from Yethal/nu_plugin_hcl@0.114.1 and signed under the official trust root.
Walk directory trees with the jwalk crate. CI-built from fdncred/nu_plugin_jwalk@v0.26.0 and signed under the official trust root.
A collection of string utilities for Nushell. CI-built from fdncred/nu_plugin_strutils@v0.22.0 and signed under the official trust root.
Query git repositories with GQL and return structured Nushell data. CI-built from fdncred/nu_plugin_query_git@v0.24.0 and signed under the official trust root.
Generate and parse ULIDs in Nushell. CI-built from lizclipse/nu_plugin_ulid@v0.23.0 and signed under the official trust root.
gettext-style translation helpers for Nushell programs. CI-built from rhino-linux/nu_plugin_nutext@0.6.2 and signed under the official trust root.
Check GitHub service health from Nushell. Registry-hosted mirror of upstream commit 81756dc. Install-only: script activation is deferred in Numan.
Browse Hacker News from Nushell. Registry-hosted mirror of upstream commit 6cd8aef. Install-only: script activation is deferred in Numan.

neofetch-like system info script in Nushell. Registry-hosted mirror of upstream commit 15e0645. Install-only: script activation is deferred in Numan. Note: upstream repo has no LICENSE file at this pin.
Cargo custom completions from nu_scripts. Registry-hosted mirror of nu_scripts/custom-completions/cargo @ f04cb44. Install-only: completion activation is deferred in Numan.
npm custom completions from nu_scripts. Registry-hosted mirror of nu_scripts/custom-completions/npm @ f04cb44. Install-only: completion activation is deferred in Numan.
make custom completions from nu_scripts. Registry-hosted mirror of nu_scripts/custom-completions/make @ f04cb44. Install-only: completion activation is deferred in Numan.
winget custom completions from nu_scripts. Registry-hosted mirror of nu_scripts/custom-completions/winget @ f04cb44. Install-only: completion activation is deferred in Numan.

Git aliases for Nushell (overlay use). Registry-hosted mirror of upstream commit 109cc61. Install-only: script activation is deferred in Numan; after install, overlay use the installed git-aliases.nu path.
